external_deps: Claude Code or another supported coding agent

review.tagline: Skills and plugins library for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor
review.summary: A collection of SKILL.md instruction packages, stdlib-only Python CLI scripts and reference docs across 20 domains, including engineering, marketing, compliance, C-level advisory and research. It installs as Claude Code plugins from a marketplace, or converts with scripts/convert.sh into Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, Kilo Code, OpenCode and Augment formats. Personas and agent definitions are included.
review.audience: Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want ready-made skills
strengths: Python tools are stdlib-only, no pip installs required
Installs via Claude Code plugin marketplace, per domain or per skill
convert.sh and install.sh target Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Augment
Includes a skill-security-auditor to scan skills before installation
weaknesses: Broad scope; many domains are non-coding (marketing, finance, compliance)
README counts are inconsistent (345 vs 388 skills, 5,200+ stars claim)
Hermes Agent and Mistral Vibe need a manual one-time sync script
Windows needs a symlink-enabled clone and PYTHONUTF8=1 for mirror trees
needs: Needs Python 3, Claude Code or another supported coding agent
